evidence: Returns profile options bit 5 / championship entry flags bit 0; stored in every best-time record as the bit the record lists show as "AT" (else "MT"); defaults to 1.
Writes the bit RallyData_GetDriverAutomaticGearbox reads (profile options bit 5, or championship flags bit 0 plus the edited bit).
Returns g_frameRate (1000 / the last frame time in ms); its callers print it with the fps format or pass it to StageObject_SetFrameRate.
Called every frame with Graphics_GetFrameRate() in 16.16 (25 at reset); sets g_stageObjectScale = rate / 25 and g_stageObjectTimeStep = its reciprocal.
All callers pass the car box, body axes, position and eight world corners; computes horizontal axes and extents, stores geometry pointers, sets built and builds the footprint.
Only caller is Collision_BuildCarBox; scales CollisionBox axes by half extents, writes points[0..3] and translates them by position with y fixed to box top.
Returns the indexed CollisionBox from the eight-car table at 0x590ed0; Collision_TestCarAgainstSectorEdges uses it as g_collisionFace.

Reads the six ObjectPointBounds fields stored by Collision_BuildObjectPointBounds, expands them by 512 and constructs a cached CollisionBox translated to the object position; no sprite data is accessed.
Caches the object position, SectorObjectBounds::radius and the first MeshCollisionRecord::height; called when the sector entry has no box projection, with no material access.
Projects the object sphere centre onto the car box axes, tests half extents plus radius, and calls CarPhysics_UpdateWheelSlipAndVelocityDamping; reads no rendering or lighting state.
